items.title: Land a magazine publication from the Rio trip
items.text: The outcome I want from the Rio trip is {{a magazine publication}}.
items.note: Everything else in Rio (models, stylists, venues) feeds this one result.

items.title: Shoot 2-3 strong Rio editorials before 4 December
items.text: Before I leave Rio I want to have shot {{2 to 3 strong editorials}}.
items.note: Strong means a full story a magazine could run, not a test.

items.title: Turn the Rio Meta campaign into steady shoot bookings
items.text: The paid Rio campaign should become {{a steady flow of shoot bookings}}, not just clicks.
items.note: Campaign: rio - website - pt, sending women in Rio to /sign-up-collab-rio.

items.title: Choose the next city and set it up before arriving
items.text: After Rio, the goal is to {{choose the next city and set it up before I arrive}}.
items.note: Set up means outreach sent, a sign-up page live and ads running before landing.

items.title: Make the São Paulo week produce one strong shoot
items.text: My São Paulo dates are {{24 to 30 November}}.
items.note: One week. Whatever is not booked before arriving probably will not happen.

items.title: Build an Instagram grid that wins agencies and magazines
items.text: My Instagram grid plan holds {{126 picks}}, portraits interleaved with documentary.
items.note: Saved at /picks.

items.title: Turn the film archive into frames I can pitch and post
items.text: The point of the Lightroom and negative work is {{an archive of finished frames I can pitch and post}}.
items.note: Rotating, cropping and converting are means, not the goal.

items.title: Find out whether people will pay for the dating photo generator
items.text: The question for the dating profile photo generator is {{will people pay for it}}.
items.note: Not 'can it be built'. That is already known.

items.title: Choose one accountability app idea and validate it
items.text: For the accountability app the goal is to {{choose one idea and validate it}}.
items.note: One idea, tested properly, beats five half-tested.

items.title: Get one consumer app idea to earn a build
items.text: Across all my app ideas the goal is {{one idea that passes the build threshold}}.
items.note: Hundreds of offer pages are live. None counts until one earns a build.

items.title: Land a magazine publication from the Rio trip
items.text: A magazine publication matters because {{published work is what agencies, stylists and brands check before they say yes}}.
items.note: One published story makes every later pitch easier.

items.title: Shoot 2-3 strong Rio editorials before 4 December
items.text: My deadline for the Rio editorials is {{4 December}}, the day I leave.
items.note: Count the free shoot days left and give each editorial a date.

items.title: Turn the Rio Meta campaign into steady shoot bookings
items.text: The Rio website campaign runs at {{$2 a day}}.
items.note: Cheap enough to keep on. The question is whether sign-ups turn into shoots.

items.title: Choose the next city and set it up before arriving
items.text: Setting a city up before arriving matters because {{the first week is otherwise lost to waiting on replies}}.
items.note: Rio showed how long agencies, venues and magazines take to answer.

items.title: Make the São Paulo week produce one strong shoot
items.text: The goal for the São Paulo week is {{one strong shoot I can pitch}}.
items.note: One finished story beats three loose tests.

items.title: Build an Instagram grid that wins agencies and magazines
items.text: The grid matters because {{agencies and magazines look at it before they answer a pitch}}.
items.note: With about 200 pitches out, people are looking this week.

items.title: Turn the film archive into frames I can pitch and post
items.text: The film archive matters because {{it is where the grid, the portfolio and the magazine edits come from}}.
items.note: Unedited scans cannot be sent to anyone.

items.title: Find out whether people will pay for the dating photo generator
items.text: The dating test compares four ideas: AI shoot, camera-roll edit, profile audit and {{swipe test}}.
items.note: Each has its own 'launching soon' page, so sign-ups show which one people want.

items.title: Choose one accountability app idea and validate it
items.text: Validating means {{strangers sign up or say they would pay}}, before any code is written.
items.note: Same thresholds as every other app idea.

items.title: Get one consumer app idea to earn a build
items.text: Every app offer must start from {{demand already visible in the market}}, never from a guess.
items.note: Evidence from 3 or more people plus a sign that money is already being spent.

items.title: Land a magazine publication from the Rio trip
items.text: About {{200}} 'Editorial proposal: Rio de Janeiro' pitches have gone out to magazines. The goal now is turning replies into a yes.
items.note: Sending is done. The work is answering every reply fast and with strong images.

items.title: Shoot 2-3 strong Rio editorials before 4 December
items.text: Venues that already replied to my Rio outreach include Rubaiyat, Noi Gastronomia and {{Fasano}}.
items.note: A yes from a venue is only worth something once a shoot date is on it.

items.title: Turn the Rio Meta campaign into steady shoot bookings
items.text: The measure of success for the Rio campaign is {{booked shoots per week}}, not sign-ups.
items.note: Follow each sign-up to the end: replied, date set, shot.

items.title: Choose the next city and set it up before arriving
items.text: I leave Rio on {{4 December}}, so the next city has to be chosen with enough time to send outreach first.
items.note: Agencies and venues need lead time.

items.title: Make the São Paulo week produce one strong shoot
items.text: The São Paulo week matters because {{it widens the trip beyond Rio for magazines and agencies}}.
items.note: A second city makes the Brazil work a body of work.

items.title: Build an Instagram grid that wins agencies and magazines
items.text: The grid plan mixes portraits with {{documentary frames}} so it reads as one photographer.
items.note: The order is already decided. The goal is to get it published.

items.title: Turn the film archive into frames I can pitch and post
items.text: An archive shoot is finished when {{its best frames are edited and exported}}, not when it is imported.
items.note: The next milestone is one old shoot taken all the way to exported selects.

items.title: Find out whether people will pay for the dating photo generator
items.text: My rule for building an app is 1 pre-order, 3 'I'd pay' clicks, or {{10 sign-ups in 72 hours}}.
items.note: The dating ideas get judged against this, nothing softer.

items.title: Choose one accountability app idea and validate it
items.text: One accountability candidate is commitment-based work sessions at {{$9 a month}}.
items.note: Blocking, one clear task and an accountability partner.

items.title: Get one consumer app idea to earn a build
items.text: An app idea earns a build with {{1 pre-order}}, 3 'I'd pay' clicks, or 10 sign-ups in 72 hours.
items.note: The single pre-order is the strongest signal of the three.

items.title: Land a magazine publication from the Rio trip
items.text: Noctis will decide on publication once they see {{the final images}}, so the next milestone is a tight edit sent to Genea Bailey.
items.note: A magazine judges the weakest frame. Send fewer, stronger.

items.title: Shoot 2-3 strong Rio editorials before 4 December
items.text: Each Rio editorial needs three things locked: a stylist, an agency model and {{a venue that said yes}}.
items.note: The next milestone is one shoot with all three confirmed on a calendar date.

items.title: Turn the Rio Meta campaign into steady shoot bookings
items.text: The Rio campaign sends people to {{/sign-up-collab-rio}}, so that page and my reply speed decide the bookings.
items.note: The next milestone is the first shoot that came from the ad.

items.title: Choose the next city and set it up before arriving
items.text: A city is set up when it has three things: outreach sent, a city sign-up page and {{a paid campaign pointing at it}}.
items.note: The same kit Rio has: /sign-up-collab-rio plus rio - website - pt.

items.title: Make the São Paulo week produce one strong shoot
items.text: The next milestone for São Paulo is {{a confirmed shoot date inside 24 to 30 November}}.
items.note: Mafê Domingues is the open conversation there.

items.title: Build an Instagram grid that wins agencies and magazines
items.text: The Instagram goal is met when {{the planned grid is live on my profile}}, not saved as a plan.
items.note: The next milestone is the first full row posted.

items.title: Turn the film archive into frames I can pitch and post
items.text: The measure of progress on the archive is {{the number of shoots with exported selects}}.
items.note: Not hours spent in Lightroom.

items.title: Find out whether people will pay for the dating photo generator
items.text: The dating demand test costs {{$3 a day}}, about $42 over two weeks.
items.note: A small price for knowing which idea to build.

items.title: Choose one accountability app idea and validate it
items.text: Another accountability candidate is task-start support at {{$12 a month}}: live starts and small next actions.
items.note: For people who know what to do and cannot begin.

items.title: Get one consumer app idea to earn a build
items.text: Offer pages get no sign-ups without {{traffic}}, which is the part that still depends on me.
items.note: The posting scripts are written. Nothing is posted automatically.

items.title: Land a magazine publication from the Rio trip
items.text: I will know this goal is met when {{a magazine confirms a story in writing}}.
items.note: Interest and 'send us more' are progress, not the finish line.

items.title: Shoot 2-3 strong Rio editorials before 4 December
items.text: The Rio editorials matter because {{they are the stories I pitch to magazines}}.
items.note: No editorials, no publication.

items.title: Turn the Rio Meta campaign into steady shoot bookings
items.text: If Rio sign-ups come in but no shoots happen, the thing to fix is {{how fast and how clearly I follow up}}.
items.note: A sign-up goes cold within a day or two.

items.title: Choose the next city and set it up before arriving
items.text: The next milestone for the next city is simply {{deciding which city it is}}.
items.note: Nothing else can start until that is fixed.

items.title: Find out whether people will pay for the dating photo generator
items.text: Testing before building matters because {{the 60 offers I launched from guesses all failed}}.
items.note: Your own rule since 18 October: no offer from a guess.

items.title: Choose one accountability app idea and validate it
items.text: The next milestone for the accountability app is {{picking the one idea to test}}.
items.note: Everything else waits on that choice.

items.title: Shoot 2-3 strong Rio editorials before 4 December
items.text: An editorial counts as done when {{the final edit is delivered and pitched}}, not when the shoot wraps.
items.note: Unedited shoots are the easiest thing to leave behind when you change city.

items.title: Find out whether people will pay for the dating photo generator
items.text: I kill an app idea after {{7 days under 3 sign-ups}}.
items.note: So the dating test needs a start date and an end date.

items.title: Choose one accountability app idea and validate it
items.text: The accountability idea has earned a build when it gets 1 pre-order, {{3 'I'd pay' clicks}}, or 10 sign-ups in 72 hours.
items.note: Below that, keep testing or kill it.

items.title: Find out whether people will pay for the dating photo generator
items.text: The next milestone for the dating app is {{the first real number: sign-ups per idea}}.
items.note: Until the test runs there is nothing to decide on.
